title: Clawbacks on Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
Value is taken back only from a Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument whose type allows clawback (Bonus Gift Card and Return Store Credit). A clawback is limited to the instrument's current balance; whatever cannot be recovered is settled under the Returns & Exchanges terms or written off, and the balance never goes below zero.

## Clauses in force

1. **Bonus Gift Card.** A Bonus Gift Card is clawed back when the gift card purchase that earned it is cancelled or refunded so that the order no longer contains the blocks the bonus was issued for (reason: qualifying purchase refunded). A bonus card still in pending activation is voided instead.
2. **Ceiling.** A clawback is limited to the current balance.
3. **Unrecovered value.** What the current balance cannot cover is settled under the Returns & Exchanges terms or written off; the balance never goes below zero.
4. **One per cause.** Only one clawback is made per instrument for each return or order that caused it.

## Bonus Gift Card by status

| Status of the Bonus Gift Card when the qualifying purchase is undone | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Pending activation | Voided instead of clawed back |
| Active | Clawed back, limited to the current balance |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A clawback owed on a Bonus Gift Card holding 12.00 takes back at most 12.00, leaving a balance of 0.00; the balance does not become negative.
- A Return Store Credit already carries a clawback booked for a given return; no second clawback is made on that instrument for the same return.
- A Goodwill Credit is never clawed back, because its type does not allow clawback.

## Retired clause

The following clause of this policy is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis for recovering instant store credit after inspection: "Return Store Credit issued before a return was inspected is clawed back for the value of the units the returns charter rejects at inspection (reason: failed return inspection)."

superseded_clauses: Return Store Credit issued before a return was inspected is clawed back for the value of the units the returns charter rejects at inspection (reason failed_return_inspection).
